summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads a Bun v1.3.13 runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball (execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])). `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line Bun script (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) heavily obfuscated with a string-array rotator cipher (functions WV8StW / hc1jfK9, numeric decoder table n7gIxM) and hex-mangled identifiers, containing `with`-in-strict-mode constructs that defeat standard JS static analysis. The alternate-runtime dispatch — pulling in Bun purely to execute a bundled opaque script — bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners that trace only Node imports. This behavior is unrelated to the declared purpose of the package (a React admin-SQL-table component library whose `dist/` sources appear repackaged from the legitimate ServiceTitan project). The package is published under the `@servicetitan/` npm scope impersonating an internal ServiceTitan component, with peerDependencies on other @servicetitan/* packages, consistent with scope hijack or malicious republish. dist/api/data-tools.api.js also contains network primitives (ping, GET, POST) at the code level.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
